finding: Rider experience vs efficiency: Pearson r = 0.42 (p < 0.001)

finding: Repeat rate 60.7%, 2.05 orders per customer, month-3 retention 12.8%

finding: Checkout to delivered 86.65%; cancellation 13.35%; no pre-checkout drop-off in the event data
